datasets.name: PortInf
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.ID creditid
     , p.creditlineamount
     , p.numberofcredit
     , u.id projectid
     , u.description project
     , d.NAME district
     , v.NAME village
  FROM cm_business_plan b
     , cm_portfolio p
     , agro_village v
     , agro_region d
     , cm_usergroups u
 WHERE (b.creditid = p.ID)
   AND (b.villageid = v.ID)
   AND (v.depend_id = d.ID)
   AND (p.usrgroup = u.ID)
   AND creditid = :creditid
